articles.title: UPSC Quiz – 2026 : IASbaba’s Daily Current Affairs Quiz 2nd November 2026
articles.summary: Scientists at the National Institute of Plant Genome Research (NIPGR), New Delhi, have successfully identified CNGC13 (Cyclic Nucleotide-Gated Channel 13), a gene/channel previously uncharacterized. This significant discovery by Indian researchers marks an important advancement in understanding plant genomics. Such findings could pave the way for future breakthroughs in agricultural sciences, potentially leading to improved crop varieties and enhanced plant resilience.

articles.title: UPSC Quiz – 2026 : IASbaba’s Daily Current Affairs Quiz 30th October 2026
articles.summary: The Union Cabinet approved the Container Manufacturing Promotion Scheme (CMPS) on October 28, 2026, allocating a substantial 10,000 crore budget up to FY 2039-40. This significant initiative aims to bolster domestic container manufacturing capabilities. For SSB aspirants, this highlights the government's focus on enhancing national industrial self-reliance and infrastructure, crucial for economic growth and logistics support.

articles.title: moseslukegeomap added to PyPI
articles.summary: This service automates the creation of clean, publication-ready maps from raw GIS data like shapefiles, GeoJSON, and KML. It processes uploaded geospatial files to generate visually clear maps with areas colored by data and non-overlapping labels. This technology streamlines complex geospatial visualization, enabling efficient production of professional-grade maps vital for informed decision-making across various fields, including planning and analysis.

articles.title: St. Louis' 1908 Blind Girls' Home suffered water damage and alterations; a $4.6 million restoration uncovered its grand staircase and created affordable apartments
articles.summary: The article critically examines modern renovation trends, noting how original architectural features like unique walls and ceiling beams are often covered instead of being genuinely preserved. It questions the superficial nature of such updates, implying a deeper discussion on authentic restoration versus quick fixes, and their broader impact on architectural integrity and value.

articles.title: Sourav Ganguly's personality rights violated? Delhi high court directs 'Doosra' makers to add disclaimer, furnish Rs 2 crore guarantee
articles.summary: The Delhi High Court addressed alleged violations of cricketing legend Sourav Ganguly's personality rights by the makers of 'Doosra'. The court mandated them to add a disclaimer and furnish a Rs 2 crore guarantee, emphasizing judicial protection for individuals' rights against unauthorized commercial use. This case highlights legal safeguards for public figures within the national judicial framework.

articles.title: DAILY CURRENT AFFAIRS IAS | UPSC Prelims and Mains Exam – 2nd November 2026
articles.summary: ISRO successfully accomplished the GSLV-F18/NVS-03 mission on October 30th, enhancing India's satellite navigation capabilities. This mission significantly boosts indigenous technology development and strengthens India's space sovereignty. For SSB aspirants, it signifies India's growing self-reliance in critical space infrastructure, crucial for strategic independence and technological advancement, underpinning national security and economic growth.

articles.title: Delhi HC says 'Doosra' infringes Sourav Ganguly's personality rights but refuses to interfere with its screening
articles.summary: The Delhi High Court ruled that the film "Doosra" prima facie violated cricketer Sourav Ganguly's personality rights. Despite this finding, the court refused to halt the movie's theatrical screening. This decision allows the film to proceed with its release while acknowledging potential legal concerns regarding the unauthorized use of Ganguly's persona, setting a precedent for celebrity rights in entertainment.

articles.title: IAF hands over 39.5 acres of land parcel near Lok Kalyan Marg to Centre
articles.summary: The Indian Air Force has transferred 39.5 acres of land, comprising a sports complex and a swimming pool, to the Union Housing and Urban Affairs Ministry. This significant asset reallocation between government entities highlights efficient resource management and inter-ministerial cooperation for national development. Such transfers ensure optimal utilization of public infrastructure for broader societal benefit.

articles.title: Premji Invest backs Hical Technologies with $30-40 million for expansion
articles.summary: Aerospace and defence electromechanical components manufacturer Hical Technologies has secured $30-40 million in equity funding from Premji Invest. This significant investment will be utilized to expand its manufacturing capabilities, boosting indigenous production in the crucial defence sector. Such funding strengthens India's self-reliance in defence technology and industrial capacity, crucial for national security.

articles.title: Philippines nears deal to buy more BrahMos missiles – report
articles.summary: The Philippines is nearing an $800 million deal with India to acquire additional BrahMos supersonic cruise missiles, significantly strengthening its coastal defenses. This procurement builds upon their previous missile acquisitions, highlighting growing strategic cooperation between the two nations. The move reinforces Manila's capabilities in enhancing regional security and maritime deterrence amidst evolving geopolitical landscapes.

articles.title: Chomsky and the Two Cultures of Statistical Learning
articles.summary: During a 2011 MIT symposium, Prof. Noam Chomsky critically addressed machine learning researchers. He derided those employing purely data-driven methods, asserting they lacked the scientific rigor of theory-driven research. This highlights a foundational debate in artificial intelligence regarding the crucial balance between statistical learning and robust theoretical frameworks for advancing our understanding of minds and machines.
